description: Windows Event Log (EVTX) logon artifact analysis -- a easy-tier forensics challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Windows Event Log (EVTX) logon artifact analysis"
